events.what_it_is: DedCool's first fully shoppable NYC cafe-and-retail pop-up, built around the launch of its Mocha Magic fragrance with drinks, fragrance sampling, exclusive merchandise and gifts.
events.what_is_free: Fragrance sampling is available, and the first 50 people in line each day receive a special gift. Other merchandise and some cafe items are for purchase.
events.caveats: Current Partiful discovery and independent launch coverage agree on September 18–20 at 262 Mott Street. Partiful publishes 9 AM–6 PM daily and says the first 50 people in line each day receive a special gift. RSVP is available through Partiful, while current event coverage describes the pop-up as open to the public; RSVP is therefore treated as optional rather than approval-based or guaranteed admission.
events.practical_notes: Friday through Sunday, September 18–20, 9 AM–6 PM daily. Arrive early if the first-50 gift is the priority.

events.address: Pier 17, 89 South St, New York, NY 10038
events.what_it_is: A one-afternoon Dunkin' sampling truck at Pier 17 serving samples of seasonal drinks and branded swag.
events.what_is_free: Free samples of Iced Pumpkin Latte, Berry Clementine Refresher and Strawberry Dragon Fruit Refresher, plus Dunkin' swag, while supplies last.
events.caveats: Average Socialite and NYC for FREE independently agree on Friday, September 18, 2:30–6 PM at Pier 17/89 South Street and describe it as open to the public. Samples and swag are while supplies last; no advance RSVP requirement is published.
events.practical_notes: Friday, September 18, 2:30–6 PM at Pier 17. Walk-in; arrive earlier for the best chance at samples and swag.

events.address: LilliStar at Moxy Williamsburg, 353 Bedford Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11211
events.what_it_is: 8it's one-day food and culture festival debuting three chef collaborations, Hennessy cocktails, unreleased DJ music and a limited-run customizable New York Penn jacket.
events.what_is_free: Admission is paid. Every guest receives a passport; completing all three food-drop stamps earns a limited-edition New York Penn tote. Guests 21+ are welcomed with one Hennessy cocktail on arrival according to the organizer release.
events.caveats: 8it's current organizer release publishes Saturday, September 19, 2–8 PM, rain or shine, at LilliStar. Advance tickets are $15 and door tickets $20; food drops are purchased separately onsite. Reserved group tables are $500. The event is 21+.
events.practical_notes: Saturday, September 19, 2–8 PM at LilliStar. This is a paid-ticket event, not a free RSVP or guest-list event.
